'''Wonn Uzalg''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] attaché during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Biography==
At the request of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gennad Rozhdenst]] and [[Kodir of Kuhlvult]], Wonn Uzalg traveled to [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] on an emergency basis during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. He was presented with evidence, by [[Kodir of Kuhlvult|Kodir]], that incorrectly implicated [[Kuat of Kuat/Legends|Kuat of Kuat]] in a scheme against [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|the Rebellion]].
After weighing the evidence, Uzalg installed Kodir as head of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and promised no surprise if something should ''happen'' to Kuat of Kuat.
